feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 6 October 2026 4:15pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 06 October 2026 at 4:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds later.


##Synopsis##

Frontal system over north Wales and northern England will move away southeastwards, leaving a northwest airstream in the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

North 3 or 4, increasing North or Northwest 4 or 5 tonight, then Northwest 5 occasionally 6 later tomorrow afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming slight or moderate tomorrow.


##Weather##

Patchy rain clearing, scattered showers tomorrow.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain or showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Becoming generally Northwest 5 or 6 tomorrow evening, then decreasing 4 or 5 later tomorrow night or at first on Thursday morning. Backing West or Northwest 3 or 4 later in morning, then backing South or Southwest 4 to 6 in afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Scattered showers dying out, rain arriving from west on Thursday afternoon.


##Visibility##

Good, possibly moderate in showers and in rain later.
